name: Conic Finance 02
fix_description: In depositFor(), the exchange rate calculation relies on _curveLpToUnderlying which calls priceOracle.getUSDPrice(curveLpToken). If this oracle uses manipulable spot prices from Curve pools, use a manipulation-resistant oracle (TWAP, Chainlink, or Curve EMA oracle) to prevent flash-loan attacks on the deposit exchange rate.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC uses a sophisticated multi-stage attack chain with nested Aave v2/v3 and Balancer flash loans, repeated pool state manipulation, and three separate read-only reentrancy entry points across Curve-style pools before exploiting Conic’s depeg handling/withdraw logic. Writing it requires deep understanding of protocol-specific oracle/accounting behavior and callback timing across multiple contracts, which is well beyond a straightforward exploit.
